description: Lowest average CPU EC2 instances over the last N days from live CloudWatch. Waste evidence, not a Compute Optimizer rec. Use before proposing downsize or idle-stop.

configuration.query:
FROM metrics-aws.ec2_metrics-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - TO_DATEPERIOD(CONCAT(TO_STRING(?days), " days"))
| STATS cpu_avg = AVG(aws.ec2.metrics.CPUUtilization.avg),
        cpu_p95 = PERCENTILE(aws.ec2.metrics.CPUUtilization.avg, 95)
    BY cloud.instance.id, cloud.instance.name, cloud.machine.type, cloud.account.id
| WHERE cpu_avg < 5
| SORT cpu_avg ASC
| LIMIT 15
